CHROMIUM: [media] mediatek: Fix mdp device tree If the mdp_* nodes are under an mdp sub-node, their corresponding platform device does not automatically get its iommu assigned properly. Fix this by moving the mdp component nodes up a level such that they are siblings of mdp and all other SoC subsystems. This also simplifies the device tree. Signed-off-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> BUG=chrome-os-partner:60805 TEST=build chromeos-4.4 for elm and boot TEST=build chromeos-4.4 for kevin and boot Change-Id: I681e6a111229b195b45cff3e37a984b9a3da84e5 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/431394 Commit-Ready: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> Tested-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Minghsiu Tsai <Minghsiu.Tsai@mediatek.com> Reviewed-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org>

input_playback: Fix blocking_playback sleep time The blocking_playback function originally calculates the elapsed time from an event file and did not take into the time spent for replaying the events by evemu-play. This patch addresses this issue by introducing another pre-defined overhead latency from invoking the evemu-play to the time read by Chrome Input Handler thread to prevent almost the same amount of time wasted in sleep. BUG=none TEST=test_that DUT_IP performance_InboxInputLatency; won't sleep additional 23 seconds after injecting the test key events. android-pfq: Make Android branch configurable. This change is based on CL:456406 which was reverted in CL:456406, and partially relanded as CL:457173. Android branch to use in uprev can be configured by "android_package" and "android_import_branch" variables. Also, no longer used attrs.{android_version,android_branch} are removed. Instead, Android stages will use attrs.metadata to keep track of Android build information. This change should not change the current behavior of buildbots. Upcoming config changes will actually switch the Android branch.
